data.title: 圣路易斯 · 海滨卧榻的日光浴凝望
data.description: 私人海滩木屋的白色遮阳卧榻上，阳光与海浪波光粼粼。圣路易斯斜倚在柔软的纯白靠垫间，身着大胆而精致的落日渐变比基尼，微湿的冰蓝长发垂在饱满胸口。她单手将墨镜推至头顶，眼眸中波光荡漾，以毫无拘束的自信身姿展露着无可挑剔的黄金比例身段。
data.location: secluded luxury beach resort cabana in late afternoon
data.action: reclining on sunbed inside luxury beach cabana, sunset gradient bikini, sunglasses pushed up onto blue hair, wet skin glistening, confident captivating gaze
data.lighting: dazzling tropical daylight reflected off blue water with soft cloth canopy shade
data.mood: sun-soaked tropical glamour, irresistible confident charm
data.promptProse: Reclining luxuriously on a sunbed in a private beach cabana, St. Louis wears a vibrant sunset bikini. Sunbeams filter through canvas sails as her wet blue hair cascades over golden, dewy skin.
data.animaCaption: St. Louis relaxing on a luxury sunbed in a beach cabana wearing a stylish bikini.
